sentences.en: There was a savour of bitterness in his voice.
sentences.zh: 他的声音里带着一丝苦涩。

sentences.en: There was a savour of bitterness in her voice.
sentences.zh: 她的声音里带着一丝苦涩。

sentences.en: He paused briefly to savour the moment.
sentences.zh: 他停顿了一下，细细品味着那一刻。
